title: Field-grade model scouting & signal operationalization playbook
creator: Priya Nair
description:
High-level: Create an operational playbook and lightweight platform primitives that convert heterogeneous open-model signals into prioritized, time-bound procurement and experiment actions. This ticket scopes the PM runbook, required integration points (scouts, evals, dashboard), scoring rubric, and rollout plan for the initial pilot with the RAG and embeddings product lines.

Why: Increasing churn and rapid model releases require a repeatable process to detect promising models, evaluate runtime economics and quality on our workloads, and turn those signals into procurement or fallback decisions without blocking product teams.

Goals: 1) Define signal taxonomy and scoring (quality, cost, latency, license risk, quantization readiness). 2) Implement a minimal data pipeline to ingest weekly model meta (repo releases, benchmark results, quantization reports) and nightly evals on canonical prompt sets. 3) Build a dashboard slice for PM/Procurement with ranked model candidates and upgrade/fallback recommendations. 4) Publish the playbook and run the pilot with two product squads.
acceptance_criteria: Signal taxonomy documented and reviewed by Research & Eng
Automated ingestion of model release metadata and metrics into a staging S3 table
Weekly leaderboard dashboard shows top 10 candidate models with scores and delta from prior week
Procurement triggers defined (latency/cost thresholds) and simulated on historical data
Playbook published in Confluence with step-by-step runbook and escalation paths
tasks: Define signal taxonomy and scoring rubric (owner: Priya)
Spec minimal ingestion schema and producer contracts (owner: Eng - infra)
Implement connector to open model registry and vendor feeds (owner: Eng - integrations)
Create nightly evals harness for canonical prompts (owner: Research)
Draft procurement decision templates and SLAs (owner: Legal & Procurement)
Pilot with RAG and Embeddings squads for 4 weeks and collect feedback
